headline: Russian banks may begin crypto trading legally, with major benefits in international payments
summary: Following a new cryptocurrency law, rouble-backed stablecoins issued domestically could gain significant share in foreign trade payments over the next year, a Sberbank executive told Reuters. Russian firms face pressure to avoid traditional currencies.
why: Sberbank is Russia's largest bank, and its stance on crypto and stablecoins signals how the country's financial system may handle cross-border payments under sanctions.
